prompt: Emily, a network engineer, wants to search her LDAP directory for all entries that contain a specific email domain "@techcorp.com" under the base "dc=tech,dc=net". She wants to use simple authentication and ensure that the search results show the user's full name and email address. Which command should she use?
explanation: The ldapsearch command is used to search the LDAP directory. In this scenario, -x enables simple authentication. -b "dc=tech,dc=net" specifies the search base. The search filter (mail=*@techcorp.com) will match all entries with the specified email domain. Lastly, cn mail ensures that the results only display the user's full name (cn) and email address (mail).
